timeExit.rule: Every Teststock stock position opened on or after dayTraderModeEffectiveAt is a same-session trade and must be flat before the authoritative regular-session close.
timeExit.stalledTradeRule: Exit a stalled or invalidated intraday setup quickly rather than waiting for a distant target; never convert a losing day trade into an overnight swing.

risk.accountRiskRule: Existing Teststock cap remains authoritative; easier execution never increases risk.

requirements: exact symbol searchable and buyable in the authenticated Robinhood Agentic account
asset not restricted, halted, closing-only or unsupported
quantity and order type supported
non-margin buying power sufficient
current quote remains inside Teststock no-chase limits
no duplicate or conflicting open order exists
required protective exit path is supported
brokerEligibility.rule: ChatGPT must verify the exact candidate through the authenticated Robinhood Trading MCP immediately before submission. If any live broker, freshness, sizing, no-chase, duplicate-order or protection check fails, reject the candidate; never substitute an unranked symbol.

adaptiveLearning.rule: Positive learning influence grows automatically with reconciled sample depth and per-dimension evidence. Negative evidence, execution degradation, and protection failures may reduce or block risk sooner. The learner never creates eligibility, raises the maximum risk ceiling, rewrites code, changes funding rules, or bypasses stock approval.

profitabilityAdmissionPolicy.rule: Every stock setup remains shadow-only until at least 60 independent outcomes across 12 trading days pass positive expectancy, profit-factor, regime and safety gates. Micro probation is capped at 25%; larger size requires additional forward and Robinhood-confirmed real-fill evidence.

decisionIntelligencePolicy.portfolioObjective: Rank already-qualified candidates by setup quality, confidence, freshness, liquidity and correlation while preserving cash and hard portfolio gates.
decisionIntelligencePolicy.authority: May rerank, reduce, expire, or block. Cannot create eligibility outside an explicitly authorized automatic seed lane, raise risk, loosen a hard gate, add an asset class, or exceed the encoded seed-lane cap.

admission.reason: Forward profitability has not been independently established inside Teststock.

congressionalIntelligencePolicy.authority: Congressional disclosures are delayed research context. They cannot create live eligibility, increase size or risk, loosen a gate, or bypass per-order stock approval.

deduplication.crossSourceRule: Agreement raises data confidence; it never counts as another politician or another trade.

decay.warning: Federal disclosures can arrive long after the transaction. This is not real-time order flow.
